personality_one_liner: A modern, professional, and accessible construction management dashboard with clean hierarchy, subtle rounding, and optimal readability.

spacing.rule: Generous intentional padding around content to improve scannability without relying on harsh borders.

dont's: Do not introduce blur or glass libraries as per the performance and dependency constraints.

screens.name: Staff Dashboard
screens.purpose: Project list/cards and status counters for quick overview.

states.empty: Subtle branded illustration or system icon with soft muted text.

screens.layout: Top status counter cards (2-col grid). Below, vertical list of Project cards. Clean subtle borders (1px border on surfaceSecondary).

screens.name: Project Detail
screens.purpose: Detailed NC cards, status badges, and evidence media view.

states.empty: No NCs logged message with 'Add NC' button.
states.error: Unable to load project details with retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header. Stack of NC cards. Media thumbnails in flex row wrap. Actions prominently anchored at the bottom.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update the existing token file /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to reflect the new light and dark mode hex values provided.

Ensure WCAG AA contrast on all elements. Note: To guarantee AA compliance on the #FF5A00 accent color across states, 'onBrandPrimary' text must be #1A1A1A (dark charcoal). Do not use white text on the orange buttons unless it's strictly > 18pt bold.
Remove all 2px solid black borders and brutalist styling. Replace with 1px soft 'border' or 'borderStrong' colors.
Status colors (success, warning, error, info) should be implemented as soft tinted badge backgrounds with their matching 'on*' text, ditching the previous neon colors.

Remove Archivo from body elements and labels. Fall back to standard System fonts (or whatever existing clean non-display font is bundled) for body and UI labels, keeping Archivo exclusively for Headings.

Do NOT introduce new dependencies or animation libraries. Use existing shared primitives (Btn, Badge, Field, Card) and only refine their internal stylings (borders, radius, padding, colors) to align with this minimal, modern specification.

Fix dark mode completely: do not simply invert colors. Use the provided dark mode palette that relies on lifted grays (#1E1E1E, #2C2C2E) instead of pure black, and highly readable muted text (#A0A0A0).
